# The two-dimensional atmosphere solver {#sec-ch09}

This chapter describes the Python solver of `python/atm2d`, which advances the composition of an atmosphere on a
two-dimensional grid of columns. It holds the state, computes transport by eddy diffusion and advection, adds the
chemical and photochemical sources of @sec-ch06 and @sec-ch07, assembles the implicit operator as one sparse system,
and advances it with a Rosenbrock step of adaptive size or solves for a steady state with Newton's method. The
linear algebra it relies on is described in @sec-ch10.
